{"code":"import Mathlib

theorem fatem_020_field_ideal_eq_bot_or_top {F : Type*} [Field F] (I : Ideal F) :
    I = 0 ∨ I = ⊤ := by
  by_cases h : I = 0
  · exact Or.inl h
  · -- I ≠ 0, so there exists a non-zero element in I
    have h_ne_bot : I ≠ 0 := h
    -- Use Ideal.ne_bot_iff to get a non-zero element
    have h_exists : ∃ x ∈ I, x ≠ 0 := by
      rw [Ideal.ne_bot_iff] at h_ne_bot
      exact h_ne_bot
    obtain ⟨x, hx_mem, hx_ne_zero⟩ := h_exists
    -- In a field, non-zero elements are units
    have hx_unit : IsUnit x := by
      rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
      exact hx_ne_zero
    -- Since x is a unit and x ∈ I, we have 1 ∈ I
    have h_one_mem : (1 : F) ∈ I := by
      -- x is a unit, so there exists y such that x * y = 1
      -- Since x ∈ I and I is an ideal, x * y ∈ I, so 1 ∈ I
      have h_inv : ∃ y, x * y = 1 := by
        obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx_unit.exists_right_inv
        exact ⟨y, by simpa [mul_comm] using hy⟩
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h_inv
      have h_xy_mem : x * y ∈ I := I.mul_mem_right y hx_mem
      rw [hy] at h_xy_mem
      exact h_xy_mem
    -- If 1 ∈ I, then I = ⊤
    have h_top : I = ⊤ := by
      apply Ideal.eq_top_iff_one_mem.mpr
      exact h_one_mem
    exact Or.inr h_top"}

theorem fatem_020_field_ideal_eq_bot_or_top {F : Type*} [Field F] (I : Ideal F) :

  by_cases h : I = 0
  · exact Or.inl h

    have h_ne_bot : I ≠ 0 := h
    -- Use Ideal.mem_bot to characterize the zero ideal
    -- If I ≠ 0, then there exists x ∈ I such that x ≠ 0
    have h_exists : ∃ x ∈ I, x ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra! h_contra
      -- If for all x ∈ I, x = 0, then I = 0
      have h_I_eq_bot : I = 0 := by
        apply Ideal.ext
        intro x
        constructor
        · intro hx
          have := h_contra x hx
          simp at this
          exact this
        · intro hx
          simp at hx
          exact hx
      contradiction
    obtain ⟨x, hx_mem, hx_ne_zero⟩ := h_exists
    -- In a field, non-zero elements are units
    have hx_unit : IsUnit x := by
      rw [isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
      exact hx_ne_zero
    -- Since x is a unit and x ∈ I, we have 1 ∈ I
    have h_one_mem : (1 : F) ∈ I := by
      -- x is a unit, so there exists y such that x * y = 1
      -- Since x ∈ I and I is an ideal, x * y ∈ I, so 1 ∈ I
      have h_inv : ∃ y, x * y = 1 := by
        obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hx_unit.exists_right_inv
        exact ⟨y, by simpa [mul_comm] using hy⟩
      obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h_inv
      have h_xy_mem : x * y ∈ I := I.mul_mem_right y hx_mem
      rw [hy] at h_xy_mem
      exact h_xy_mem
    -- If 1 ∈ I, then I = ⊤
    have h_top : I = ⊤ := by
      -- Use Ideal.ne_top_iff_one: I ≠ ⊤ ↔ 1 ∉ I
      -- Contrapositive: 1 ∈ I → I = ⊤
      have h_ne_top : I ≠ ⊤ → (1 : F) ∉ I := by
        intro h_ne
        exact (Ideal.ne_top_iff_one.mp h_ne)
      by_contra h_ne_top
      have h_one_not_mem : (1 : F) ∉ I := h_ne_top h_ne_top
      contradiction
    exact Or.inr h_top"}
